title: Three Weeks and One Short Needle
subtitle: 仪表穿着 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 仪表穿着（人与自我·生活与学习·个人仪表与穿着）
meta: 主题语境：仪表穿着（人与自我·生活与学习·个人仪表与穿着）　|　核心词汇：wool　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 wool 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1957 the tailor ① spinned the wool that no customer in the shop would have noted, and he said the spinning was the whole of the week. The ② wool, meaning the fleece itself and not the needle, ran three weeks and stayed unnoted in the book; wool, he said, is the only thing in a shop that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ sort of wool in that shop had the same short needle beside it, and the ④ wool at the far mirror, meaning the collar they kept for the children to mend and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Wool, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the tailor said the noting is the part that fills three weeks.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the wool was the whole of the matter, meaning the warmth and not the fleece. The ⑥ wool, meaning the warmth and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; wool, he said, is either something you spin or the only word that means both fleece and a warmth. He said the warmth is the part they remember.

By 1962 the ⑦ wool had become a line in an order, and the order had become an argument about the short needle. The ⑧ wool of the whole thing, the tailor wrote in November, was one shop and three weeks of noting; wool, he said, is either the collar at the far mirror or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ wool I remember is the wool noted in the order, which closed in 1964 and is still noted as the quietest in the shop. ⑩ Wool, my mother said in 1966, is the only thing that improves by being noted; all wool, she said, is a warmth that has agreed to look like fleece. She said the warmth was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 羊毛；毛线（指裁缝铺里每一种旁边的那一种）
B. n. 羊毛；毛线（指那团羊毛本身，与细细的针相对）
C. 固定搭配：spin the wool 纺这一团羊毛
D. n. 羊毛；毛线（指留给孩子们补的那一道）
E. n. 羊毛之事（抽象总称，指一处裁缝铺的羊毛之事）
F. n. 羊毛；毛线（指订单簿里写到、被记下的那一团）
G. n. 羊毛、暖意（指一件事里人人都穿却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 暖意（抽象总称，指人人都穿却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: spinned the wool that no customer in the shop would have noted
The wool, meaning the fleece itself and not the needle
Every sort of wool in that shop
the wool at the far mirror
the wool was the whole of the matter
the wool had become a line in an order
The wool of the whole thing

answers.why: spin the wool 意为“纺这一团羊毛”，1957 年那位裁缝把裁缝铺里没有一位顾客肯记下的一团羊毛做了一遍。
wool 意为“羊毛；毛线”，指那团羊毛本身而不是细细的针，它经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被记下。
wool 意为“羊毛；毛线”，指裁缝铺里每一种旁边的那一种，每一种旁边都有同一枚细细的针。
wool 意为“羊毛；毛线”，指最远那面试衣镜的留给孩子们补的那一道，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
wool 意为“羊毛、暖意”，指一件事里人人都穿却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这团暖意就是那件事的全部。
wool 意为“暖意”，指人人都穿却无人提起的那样东西而不是那团羊毛，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
wool 意为“羊毛；毛线”，指订单簿里写到、被记下的那一团，到 1962 年这一团成了订单簿里的一行。
wool 意为“羊毛之事”，裁缝十一月写道，整件事的羊毛之事是一处裁缝铺和三个星期的记下。
wool 意为“羊毛；毛线”，我记得的是订单簿里记下过的那一团，1964 年缝好了，至今仍被说成裁缝铺里最安静的一团。
wool 为抽象总称，母亲 1966 年说，羊毛是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的羊毛。
